With the switch on, the same side 2x hold plays no vibration, and the hook's log says it held one back.

The patched dex installs the screen-transition callbacks and the patch registered itself. (The dex-string steps show the extension class or constant is shipped, the whole extension is kept in the dex; the registered-switch step is what shows the patch ran.)

Hushfeed's row on TikTok's Settings and privacy is tapped while the screen is filmed: with the switch off the clip passes through a run of frames between the two screens (the slide), with it on it jumps straight to Hushfeed's page.

With the switch on, TikTok's non-personalized search gate is answered yes during a search (Hook status records it). The gate recorder can't show this: it reads the settings value under the gate, which stays 0.

The patch registered its switch. (The dex-string steps show the extension class or constant is shipped, the whole extension is kept in the dex; the registered-switch step is what shows the patch ran.)
With the switch on, TikTok's typeface requests are answered with the system font (HookStatus 'system font' records 'system'); with it off they stay TikTok's own ('tiktok').
